h1: CS Pattani Hotel — the city's flagship hotel, the first name locals think of
intro: Ask anyone in Pattani where to put up a visiting relative or a business guest, and the first name many will say is CS Pattani Hotel · A 120-room, 4-star property that has been a landmark of the city since 2003 · It sits in the Rusamilae area right by Prince of Songkla University's Pattani campus · It comes with a large outdoor pool, a restaurant, free parking, and an in-house craft museum · Standard rooms start from around THB 1,500/night

body.html: CS Pattani Hotel has been open since 2003, and for many years it was the largest hotel in the province · With 120 rooms, it can host weddings, seminars and study-tour groups in a way the city's small guesthouses simply cannot · The lobby is wide and high-ceilinged, finished in warm wood tones in an older-hotel style — and many reviews single out the evening lobby ambiance as genuinely handsome, the look of a real hotel rather than a guesthouse.

The most-praised feature is the spacious rooms with strong, reliable hot showers · Guests who've stayed at the small hotels in town and then come here often say there's space to spare, with big, comfortable beds · Some higher-floor rooms look out over the town and open fields in the distance · Parking is plentiful and free, which matters a lot for anyone arriving by car.
"Clean room, very big bed, hot water with great pressure — slept really well. Plenty of parking too. For this price in Pattani it's good value."

The outdoor pool here is large and clean, and it's a particular favorite for families travelling with kids · Several reviews note the pool is fairly quiet, with few people using it, so you get near-private space · Another thing that sets CS Pattani apart from a typical hotel is its small in-house museum displaying niello work and Lipao woven crafts, both signature handicrafts of the South — a pleasant browse before heading out.

The hotel restaurant serves both Thai and Southern dishes · Around the hotel there are also halal restaurants and local eateries within easy reach, a plus of the Rusamilae location next to the university · This spot is very close to PSU Pattani, making it ideal for parents dropping off students, people on official business, or anyone attending a meeting on campus · Old-town Pattani is about a 10–15 minute drive away.

To be straight about it, what you have to accept is that the building and furnishings are starting to show their age · Some reviews mention the room carpets look worn, parts of the decor have seen long use, and the breakfast choice isn't as varied as the big chain hotels in tourist cities · Some of the parking is a fair walk from the lobby, so if you're carrying a lot of luggage you may want to ask staff for help · This isn't a brand-new boutique hotel, but it's a flagship property that handles the basics well and can be trusted.

With 4.4 out of 5 on TripAdvisor (52 reviews · #1 in the Rusamilae area) and high scores on Trip.com, CS Pattani Hotel remains a safe choice for anyone who wants a large hotel with a pool, parking and full-service amenities at an affordable price · If you're looking for the one place you 'can't go wrong' with on a Pattani trip, this one fits the bill nicely.

honestSummary: CS Pattani Hotel is the trustworthy flagship hotel of Pattani city — spacious rooms, a large pool, free parking, and a location right by PSU Pattani · The trade-off is an aging building that's no longer brand-new, but if you want a large property that covers the basics at an affordable price, this is the safe pick.
honestChecks: If you're after a new boutique hotel with modern design — this is an older property that prioritises size and completeness over newness → consider a boutique stay in the town centre instead.
If you want to walk the old town straight from your hotel — Rusamilae is outside the centre, a 10–15 minute drive → pick a city-centre hotel if you don't have a car.
If you're self-driving or travelling as a family/group — plenty of free parking, a large pool, and family rooms available → this is the most practical pick in Pattani.

faq.q: Where is CS Pattani Hotel and what's nearby?
faq.a: CS Pattani Hotel is at 99/9 Moo 4, Nong Chik Road, Rusamilae, Mueang Pattani District · It's very close to Prince of Songkla University's Pattani campus (about a 5-minute drive) · Old-town Pattani is about 10–15 minutes away, and Rusamilae Beach about 10 minutes.

faq.q: What does CS Pattani Hotel cost and what rooms are there?
faq.a: Standard rooms start from around THB 1,500/night · Options range from Twin/Standard and Deluxe Corner to Deluxe Twin and a Family Room Deluxe (4 beds) at around THB 2,400 · Prices vary by season and platform, so compare a few sites before booking.

faq.q: Does CS Pattani Hotel have a pool and parking?
faq.a: Yes to both · There's a large outdoor swimming pool that's clean and rarely crowded · and free, ample parking, great for self-drive guests — though some of the parking is a fair walk from the lobby.

faq.q: Who is CS Pattani Hotel best for?
faq.a: It suits families, study-tour groups, parents dropping students at PSU Pattani, and self-drive travellers · It's a large hotel with a pool and parking and full-service amenities · If you'd rather have a new boutique stay in the town centre, you might look elsewhere.

faq.q: What is the museum inside the hotel?
faq.a: CS Pattani Hotel has a small display area inside the property showing niello work and Lipao woven crafts, signature handicrafts of Southern Thailand · Guests are welcome to browse — it's quick to see but adds local character.
